stance: The rights-market framework remains anchored in technical standard-setting rather than demonstrated commercial execution as C2PA advances its open specifications.
adoption_shape: Movement is confined entirely to the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity advancing from version 2.4 to 2.5, reflecting internal standards maintenance rather than reported industry adoption.
new_entrants: No outside entities or new market players have joined the disclosed update, leaving C2PA as the sole visible actor seeking to define and control media origin and history specifications.
watch_for: Whether subsequent updates show third parties actively implementing version 2.5 or if the standard remains limited to repository releases at spec.c2pa.org.
